snippet.title: Ropeman | Grappling Hook Rope Action Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Ropeman is a 2D platformer where you throw a knife into walls attach a rope and swing like a pendulum.
Using only your rope swing skill you must keep climbing upward and reach the moon.
This game focuses on precision movement momentum and physics based action.

Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134680/Ropeman/
